3293-5412-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5412-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5412-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

7084-8227-8338.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-8227-8338.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1453-4694-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-5315-7306.description:

When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1895-2811-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-2811-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2459-4336-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3375-3532-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3933-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {4} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3933-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1169-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1169-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2760-4762-7325.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-3967-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3967-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

423-1437-1671-2895.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-1671-2895.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
The Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1417-2034-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.

Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2079-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

907-1399-1606-2957.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

397-5670-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
397-5670-6458.notablePrerequisites:

Your life total is at least 2.

Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1879-3204-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1879-3204-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1308-4452-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-1477-5263.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Extruder abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat.

1379-3003-4231-5184-5966.notablePrerequisites: You control enough artifacts to reduce Rory Williams's command tax to 0.
1379-3003-4231-5184-5966.description:
Cast Rory Williams by paying {W}{U}.
Rory Williams's last ability triggers, exiling it and creating a Food token, a Clue token, and two Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Rory Williams to the command zone from exile.
Sacrifice the two Treasure tokens for {W}{U}.
Repeat.

779-1976-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-2124-2835.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
2034-2124-2835.description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2179-3609-4883.description:
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Contagion Clasp ability, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

2179-3609-3911.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Galvanic Key's ability, targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Resolve the copy of Galvanic Key's ability, untapping Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Magistrate's Scepter ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Resolve the Galvanic Key ability from step 4, untapping Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat every other turn.

Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dalakos.
1151-1183-2178-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Dalakos triggers, untapping.
